---
title: "2. Building Computers"
description: "Collaborative notes for rebuilding computers and installing Ubuntu in TEJ."
---

> **These notes are unfinished intentionally.** Students will contribute once we begin rebuilding salvaged computers and installing Ubuntu.

We will document:

- motherboard, CPU, RAM, storage, power supply, cooling, and expansion cards
- safe handling and ESD awareness
- disassembly and component identification
- determining which parts are reusable
- rebuilding systems
- BIOS/UEFI
- creating bootable media
- installing Ubuntu
- drivers, networking, and updates
- troubleshooting and documenting failures
